name: Astronaut
short: Walks, flies, and flips the switches.
duty: Plan routes, run launch switchboards, and time burns.

name: Engineer
duty: Assemble parts in order, inspect hardware, and find the failed part.

name: Physicist
duty: Compute thrust, impulse, and motion from simple physics.

name: Mathematician
duty: Work out fuel, timing, and power budgets with reserves.

name: Biologist
short: Keeps samples clean and living things safe.
duty: Follow clean-handling steps and read microscope views.

name: Medical Officer
duty: Scan vitals, find the one who needs help, and choose the calm fix.

name: Communications Lead
short: Keeps the voices of the mission connected.
duty: Tune radios, decode messages, and write short, honest reports.

name: Flight Director
duty: Prioritize alerts and decide go or no-go with the whole team.
